### UTC Date & Time

[April 22, 2026, 15:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/apr-22-2026/3pm)

### Agenda

- Pre-reading
   - **Note:** This breakout call assumes participants are familiar with the existing proposals. Relevant material:
   - EIP-8141: Frame Transaction - [spec](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8141), [forum](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8141-frame-transaction/27617)
      - [Full Account Abstraction](https://docs.fileverse.io/0xd961b83d3421bddec9d8966efabf13800617cfea/10#key=Z-XeQk6mE7uZX9Q2ZbqWkiniYi9IZ1oSbd_2vPFyt26S7Kf8gO_UHpLJ936--lp8) motivation, goals, tradeoffs
      - EIP-7906: Transaction Assertions via State Diff Opcode - [spec](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7906), [forum](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7906-transaction-assertions-via-state-diff-opcode/23130)
   - EIP-8202: Schemed Transaction - [spec](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11438), [forum](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8202-schemed-transaction/28044)
   - ERC-8221 [spec](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1658), EIP-8223: Contract Payer Transaction [spec](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11509), [forum](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8223-contract-payer-transactions/28202)
   - [Account Abstraction Link Tree](https://hackmd.io/@matt/aa-link-tree) - chronological list of AA efforts
- Series intro
   - Goals, non-goals
- Proposal updates
   - For each proposal, what's changed since ACDE 234 (i.e., the last time AA was debated in ACD)?
      - e.g., spec changes, implementations, prototypes, testing, data collection, etc.
- Compatibility discussions
   - Adoption strategy
   - Mempool
   - Statelessness / [VOPS](https://ethresear.ch/t/a-pragmatic-path-towards-validity-only-partial-statelessness-vops/22236)
   - Privacy
      - EIP-8141: https://ethresear.ch/t/frame-transactions-and-the-three-gates-to-privacy/24666
      - EIP-8224: Counterfactual Transaction - [spec](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11518/changes) 
   - PQ security
- Open discussion
